description: This file provides low-level flash memory interface implementations for Freescale MPC55xx and MPC56xx microcontrollers. It includes functions for initializing, locking, unlocking, erasing, programming, and checking the status of flash memory regions, specifically tailored for the hardware's register map and flash sectors.

methods.name: bool getAffectedBlocks(const FlashType * bPtr,uintptr_t addr,size_t size,uint32_t (* fb)[ADDR_SPACE_CNT])
methods.description: Determines which flash blocks are affected by a given address range and size by checking overlap with sectors.

methods.name: void Flash_Init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the flash interface; currently a placeholder.

methods.name: uint32_t Flash_Lock(const FlashType * fPtr,uint32_t op,uintptr_t from,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Locks or unlocks specified regions of flash memory based on provided address and operation flags.

methods.name: uint32_t Flash_Erase(const FlashType * fPtr,uintptr_t dest,uint32_t size,flashCbType cb)
methods.description: Erases specified regions of flash memory over multiple banks, using sector information.

methods.name: uint32_t Flash_ProgramPageStart(const FlashType * fPtr,uint32_t * to,uint32_t * from,uint32_t * size,flashCbType cb)
methods.description: Starts programming a page in flash memory, assuming alignment and affected bank checks.

methods.name: uint32_t Flash_CheckStatus(const FlashType * fPtr,uint32_t * to,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Checks the status of flash programming or erase operations.
